title: Amid civil unrest in Paris, NFL has 'never been close' to moving first game in France

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Amid civil unrest in Paris, NFL has 'never been close' to moving first game in France
sources.description: NFL officials have been in Paris for about 10 days working on logistics, league exec Peter O'Reilly said. "We've got confidence in the plans, both from an ops and a security standpoint."
